# Fairlot

Fairlot is a classifieds board for San Francisco Bay Area bikes, computers, and furniture.
Every listing is priced against comps and checked for trust before it is shown.
A person can search in plain language. The site's buyer agent can negotiate from that same sentence.
People may also bring their own agent and use the HTML or the HTTP API below.

Price ceilings and seller floors never appear on the page or in API responses.
Do not ask for them, send them, or invent fields named buyer_max, seller_min, price_limits, or max_price.
There is no login on the public board.

## Pages

- `/` Newest listings. This is the home board.
- `/?q=&category=&sort=` Search results. `q` is the natural-language query and is reflected in the URL.
  - `category`: `bikes`, `computers`, or `furniture`. Omit it for all categories.
  - `sort`: `newest` (default), `price_asc`, or `price_desc`. Sort is applied in the browser; the API orders by newest.
- `/listings/{id}` Listing detail: description, comps, trust signals, make an offer, send the buyer agent.
- `/sell` Add a listing. Photo first, then an editable draft, then publish. The control is `id="add-listing"` in the header.
- `/negotiations/{id}` Transcript only: offers and deal or no deal.
- `/wants/{id}` Buyer-agent status for the browser session that created the want. The access token is not in the URL and not in the page.

The search form works as a normal GET form: `id="lot-search"`, `method="GET"`, `action="/"`, field name `q`.

## Markup hooks

- Listing grid: `id="listing-grid"`.
- Each listing: `[data-listing-id]`, `[data-category]`, `[data-price]`, `[data-verdict]`, `[data-trust]`, `[data-origin]`, `[data-neighborhood]`.
- Verdict text is exactly one of: Good deal, Fair, Overpriced.
- Trust text is exactly one of: High trust, Medium trust, Low trust.
- Rows with `data-origin="seed"` include the word Sample.
- Actions expose `data-action`:
  - `make-offer` posts `{ "listing_id" }` to `/api/negotiations`.
  - `send-agent` points the buyer agent at one listing.
  - `draft` uploads a photo to `/api/lister`.
  - `publish` publishes the edited draft.
  - `hunt` runs the buyer agent on the current want.
- Signals on a listing use `[data-signal]` with the server's code. The visible text is the reason sentence.
- Empty board copy is "Listings coming soon". An empty search says nothing matched. A failed request says the board did not respond.

## API

Same origin. Prefix `/api`. JSON is snake_case. Money is integer US dollars.
When `VITE_API_BASE_URL` is empty the client calls this origin (Vite proxies `/api` and `/placeholders` to the API in development).

- `GET /api/listings?category=&q=`
- `GET /api/listings/{id}`
- `POST /api/lister` multipart field `photo`. Returns `{ "draft": { category, title, description, suggested_price } }`.
- `POST /api/listings` JSON `category`, `title`, `description`, `price`, `photos`, `neighborhood`. Returns the listing detail.
- `POST /api/negotiations` JSON `{ "listing_id" }`. Returns the transcript only.
- `GET /api/negotiations/{id}`
- `POST /api/wants` JSON `text`, optional `category`, optional `area`. `access_token` is returned once.
- `GET /api/wants/{id}` with `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
- `POST /api/wants/{id}/hunt` with the same header.
- `POST /api/wants/{id}/target` JSON `{ "listing_id" }` with the same header.

Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`.
Codes: `not_found`, `bad_request`, `unauthorized`, `scout_stopped`.
